about: Shared cases for «Dados econômicos» (app/lib/domain/gate/agenda.ts, rules.ts, evaluate.ts, plan.ts) and the SQL. Inputs are invented; every "expected" value was computed by the SQL of migration 20261120000001_dados_economicos.sql (fase-5/banco) on a throwaway PostgreSQL 15 by the generator outside the repo (.claude/backup-fase5/gen5). Instants are UTC; "local" says how each was written. Change the SQL and the TypeScript together, then re-record.

agenda.about: gate_agenda(resolved, clock, at): K = calendars of the codes of block_releases(resolved.block); K empty → []; D = trading_day_on(at) on the clock (resolved.day, else clock); coverage = economic_calendar_days rows for D − 1, D, D + 1 in every calendar of K, else null (all or nothing); rows: code not null, calendar in K, status agendado or divulgado, at in [S(D) − 120 min, E(D + 1)); [{code, at}] by at, then ord.
